name: Manifold Dual Marching Cubes
aliases: Manifold Dual Marching Cubes (ambiguous configuration handling)
definition: Precomputes a lookup table to resolve ambiguous configurations in Dual Marching Cubes by mapping each problematic cube configuration (0-255) to its ambiguous face direction, or 255 if non-problematic.
summary: Manifold Dual Marching Cubes is a surface extraction algorithm that guarantees watertight meshes by resolving ambiguous configurations inherent in standard Dual Marching Cubes.
